title: Why Stress Gives You a Burst of Energy
hook: Stress can give you a sudden, unexpected jolt of energy.

narration.text: Stress can give you a sudden, unexpected jolt of energy.
This happens because of your body's 'fight or flight' response.
When stressed, your brain signals the adrenal glands.
They release hormones like adrenaline and cortisol into your bloodstream.
These hormones rapidly increase your heart rate and blood pressure.
Your muscles tense, preparing you for immediate action.
This ancient survival mechanism helps you face danger or escape it.
Recognising this response can help us understand our reactions to pressure.
Have you ever felt this sudden energy during a stressful moment?

description: Ever wondered why you feel a sudden surge of energy when under pressure? It's your body's ancient 'fight or flight' response kicking in. Learn how adrenaline and cortisol prepare you for immediate action.
topic: Why you feel a surge of energy during a stressful situation, explaining the fight or flight response.
